text:
Maya: Quick Q — I'm in Copenhagen Wed–Fri, working near Nørreport/Torvehallerne. Looking for a good smørrebrød spot for a team lunch Thu, and something late-night Friday (open after 11). Any must-eats? Also great coffee/bakery recs welcome :coffee:

Javier: For smørrebrød, go to Aamanns if you want a classic, but it's a bit spendy. Kødbyens Fiskebar is great for fish options. If you want quick & authentic, try `Schønnemann` — they do old-school open-faced and the rye is unreal.

Olivia: +1 Schønnemann. Pro tip: arrive early or reserve — it fills up. For coffee near Torvehallerne check "Coffee Collective" (they roast local).

Sam: Late-night: Kebab King on Istedgade is a reliable after-bar move. If you want something nicer and open late, `Palæo` does late bowls sometimes, but double-check hours.

Kris: If you're sweet-toothed, head to Meyers Bageri for cinnamon rolls and spandauer. Also Torvehallerne has a great fish stall for quick bites.

Maya: Thanks! Any chance someone can recommend a place that can handle a group of ~8 without advance booking? We want something casual, not formal.

Javier: Try WarPigs in Kødbyen — BBQ place, walk-ins often work for groups, good beer selection for team drinks. Also Hija de Sanchez (tacos) near Christianshavn is casual and tasty.

Olivia: If you prefer sit-down smørrebrød with reservations, `Schønnemann` and `Aamanns` both take bookings. If walk-in only, `Hallernes Smørrebrød` at Torvehallerne is good and faster.

Sam: FoodieBot suggests top 3 by proximity to Nørreport: 1) Coffee Collective (coffee) 2) Hallernes Smørrebrød (fast open-faced) 3) Meyers Bageri (bakery) — link: https://foodie.example/ct/cph-top3 (auto-suggestion) :robot_face:

Maya: Awesome, saving these. Anyone up for a quick post-lunch meetup Thu 1pm at the Torvehallerne coffee stand? If so reply with :thumbsup: and I'll pencil it in.

Kris: :thumbsup: I can join.

Javier: :thumbsup: Count me in.

Olivia: :thumbsup: Might be a little late but will try.

Maya: Sweet — will reserve Schønnemann just in case (and fallback to Hallernes if they can't fit 8). Thanks all for recs :pray:

Sam: If you need a delivery address for office lunch let me know — can help coordinate.

Maya: Will DM you the office details. Appreciate it!
